name: Fuwa Taisei
source:
Main character. A third-year student at the school.

He is a virgin whose unreliability tickles the maternal instincts of older women. He likes his homeroom teacher, Yuuko, although he doesn't realize it.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/hoken/index.html]official site[/url]]
